title: Shop Navigation
description:
### <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

**As** an international online shopper,  
**I want** a clearly structured, responsive, and easy-to-use navigation system  
**so that** I can seamlessly browse products, switch between locales, and access all necessary shopping tools regardless of my location or device.

---

* **Account Login / Profile**

    * Quick access to login or view user profile.
    * If logged in, show user logged in icon button
    
* **Wishlist**

    * Icon-based entry to view saved items.
    * Badge to indicate the number of saved items.
    
* **Shopping Cart**

    * Persistent icon with cart badge (number of items).
    * Flyout on hover/click with cart summary and quick links to checkout or cart page.
    
        * **MVP default is without hover dropdown/flyout**

## **Non-Functional Requirements**

* Responsive across all breakpoints (desktop, tablet, mobile).
* WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance (keyboard navigation, contrast, etc.).
* Performance-optimized: lazy load flyout content, async API for search suggestions.
* Internationalization-ready (i18n support for text, right-to-left layouts where applicable).
* SEO-friendly: Use semantic HTML, structured data where needed.
*
